create.title: Create a room
create.intro: Pick the rules, send the code or link to your friends and start when everyone is ready.

private.title: Private room
private.description: Joinable with the code or link only.

public.title: Public room
public.description: Listed with the public rooms, anyone can join.

create.playlistRequired: Pick a playlist to create the room.

errors.notEnoughTracks: This music set does not have enough tracks for {{n}} rounds ({{missing}} short). Remove a filter or pick fewer rounds.
errors.playlistNotFound: This playlist is no longer available or was turned off. The list has been reloaded, pick another one.
errors.rateLimited: You are going too fast. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.locked: Your account is locked, so you cannot create a room.
errors.rejected: The room settings are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.unknown: Could not create the room. Try again.

join.label: Have a room code?
join.placeholder: Enter the code or paste the link
join.invalid: A room code is 6 letters and digits, for example MEL889.

invalid-code.title: Invalid room code
invalid-code.description: A room code is 6 letters and digits. Check the link or code you were sent.

not-found.title: Room not found
not-found.description: This room code does not exist or the room is closed. Ask your friends again or create a new room.

full.title: This room is full
full.description: The room already has its maximum number of players. Wait for someone to leave or create a new room.

kicked.title: You were removed from the room
kicked.description: The host removed you, so you cannot rejoin this room. You can still create a new one.

locked.title: Account locked
locked.description: Your account cannot join any room for now.

rate-limited.title: You are going too fast
rate-limited.description: Wait a moment, then try joining again.

unknown.title: Could not join the room
unknown.description: Something went wrong while joining. Try again.

lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.inProgress: A match is in progress, you will play from the next one

link.reconnecting: Connection lost, reconnecting. What you see may be out of date.

code.heading: Room code
code.copyFailedHint: The browser blocked copying. Select the code and copy it by hand.

actions.label: Room actions
actions.needPlayers: At least 2 players are needed to start.

countdown.heading: Match starts in
countdown.waiting: Waiting for more players ({{n}}/{{max}}). The countdown starts with 2 players.

stopped.PLAYER_LEFT: Someone left, so the countdown stopped.
stopped.NOT_ENOUGH_PLAYERS: Not enough players, so the countdown stopped.

countdown.soloHint: Waiting a while? You can play solo right now, or create a private room to invite friends (it does not count for the ranking).

kick.title: Remove {{name}} from the room?
kick.description: A removed player cannot rejoin this room.

errors.notHost: Only the host can do this.
errors.notInLobby: The match has started, so this cannot change now.
errors.rateLimited: You are going too fast. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.

start.NOT_ENOUGH_PLAYERS: At least 2 connected players are needed to start.
start.NOT_ALL_READY: Some players are not ready yet.
start.NOT_ENOUGH_TRACKS: This music set does not have enough tracks for the chosen rounds ({{n}} short). Change the music or pick fewer rounds.
